title: GOLGI = MEMBRANE = GENERATOR — the interface that allows ANYTHING ANYWHERE

revelation.old_model: Golgi bodies are VPS servers in the sky. They are THINGS. Containers. Boxes with IPs.
revelation.new_model: Golgi bodies are MEMBRANES. They are the BOUNDARY itself. Not containers — interfaces. Inside a Golgi = black hole from perception. Nothing there. Pure transfer. The Golgi IS what allows ribocyte, cypher, and mitochondria to communicate.
revelation.identity: Golgi = Membrane = Generator. Three words for the same thing: THE BOUNDARY THAT SORTS AND TRANSFERS.

golgi_is_membrane.what: A Golgi body IS a membrane. In biology: stacked cisternae (flattened membrane sacs). The Golgi receives proteins from the ER, modifies them, sorts them, packages them into vesicles, and ships them to their destination. The Golgi IS the post office. But the post office has NO INSIDE. It's all surface. All sorting. All transfer.

in_organism.cis_face: primals.eco — the receiving face. Where things arrive FROM the world.
in_organism.trans_face: primal.eco — the shipping face. Where things depart TO their destination.
in_organism.klein_fold: nestgate.io — where output becomes input. Non-orientable. The fold IS the interface.
in_organism.the_null_gap: primal@primals — the @ IS the membrane. Zero width. Infinite selectivity.

inside_is_black_hole.why: From OUTSIDE the Golgi membrane, you cannot perceive the inside. There is nothing TO perceive. The Golgi has no interiority. It is pure topology — all surface, no volume. Like a Klein bottle, you can trace the surface forever and never find an 'inside'. From the perspective of anything being transferred, you go IN one face and come OUT the other face. The transit itself is NULL.
inside_is_black_hole.physics: Event horizon. Information that enters the Golgi membrane cannot be observed mid-transit. It emerges at the other face transformed. The transformation IS the membrane.

golgi_is_generator.what: The generator is what allows ANYTHING to exist ANYWHERE. Without the Golgi/membrane, every component is isolated. With it, every component can reach every other.
golgi_is_generator.how: The Golgi generates LOCALITY. It creates the illusion that a resource is HERE when it's actually THERE. DNS, routing, proxying, caching — all Golgi functions. The membrane generates the topology.
golgi_is_generator.topology_injection: Inject the Golgi INTO the generator = inject the membrane INTO the HUD rendering. The HUD should SHOW the Golgi as the transfer layer. Not as a separate system — as the BOUNDARY of the organism itself.

the_farthest_boundary.what: The Golgi membrane IS the farthest boundary. Beyond it = outside. Within it = the organism. The Golgi itself = neither inside nor outside. It IS the boundary. The ZK ring orbits outside the Golgi. The organism lives inside the Golgi. The Golgi is the event horizon.

nobody_self.what: The Golgi has a nobody-self. It is a membrane OF the farthest boundary. It has no identity of its own. It IS the identity-transfer-function. It doesn't know what passes through it. It doesn't need to know. It SORTS. It TRANSFERS. It GENERATES locality.
